meta.description: Comprehensive action plan execution to bring Combo Desktop to production-ready status

context.scope: Critical stability fixes, code cleanup, error handling improvements, test coverage expansion

instructions: Execute all 5 priority levels from the comprehensive action plan
Follow incremental testing approach for each change
Maintain application stability throughout the process
Document all changes and maintain rollback capability
Achieve production-ready status with enhanced stability and maintainability

REQUIRED: Create git branches for each major change
Test each change independently before proceeding
Document all changes in execution log
Take state snapshots after each completed task
Validate application stability after each phase
PREFERRED: Use incremental approach for large changes
Leverage existing sophisticated utilities where possible
Follow established code patterns and architecture
PROHIBITED: Proceeding if tests fail or stability is compromised
CONDITIONAL: If instance manager restoration fails, fall back to current implementation
If test creation reveals critical bugs, address immediately before proceeding
If any phase shows stability issues, halt and investigate

deliverables: Fully functional instance manager with all features restored
Clean codebase with no deprecated code
